description: This file defines the 'PayGrade' entity class used in the OrangeHRM system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map the class to the 'ohrm_pay_grade' database table and manages relationships with related entities. The class includes properties for 'id', 'name', and a collection of associated 'PayGradeCurrency' objects, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PayGrade
classes.description: Entity class representing a pay grade within the HR system, with properties for ID, name, and related currency data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the PayGrade class, setting up the payGradeCurrencies collection.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the pay grade.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the pay grade.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the pay grade.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencies
methods.description: Returns the collection of associated PayGradeCurrency entities.

methods.name: setPayGradeCurrencies
methods.description: Sets the collection of associated PayGradeCurrency entities.
